title: How to Spot Red Flags in Islamabad. Tip #1
body: Ask what he drives, then ask whose name is on the registration. If he says "it's the family car" at 29, that's a red flag. If his bio says entrepreneur and the business is his father's plot file in Bahria, that's another one. Watch how fast marriage comes up, and how vague the timeline gets right after. If he's never introduced you to a single friend outside a DM, that's not shy, that's a pattern. If he still says "we're figuring things out" about someone from eight months ago and calls you "different" in the same sentence, leave.
caption:
Tip #1: "it's the family car" at 29 tells you everything.
